images.title: Triangles in a row
images.purpose: Show a row of matchstick triangles and ask what comes next, so the child sees a pattern waiting to be continued.
images.composition: One horizontal row of 4 triangle slots centred on a plain white page with wide space around; nothing else.
images.exact_structure: Three triangles in a line, each made of exactly 3 equal straight matchsticks, touching at one corner, all the same size, evenly spaced, drawn in teal #0072B2. A fourth triangle of exactly the same size follows at the end, drawn only as a dotted grey #6B7280 outline. Exactly 3 solid triangles, 1 dotted outline, 1 label.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a fourth triangle drawn solid, or a different number of solid triangles
triangles of different sizes or uneven spacing
images.takeaway: A row of shapes invites us to ask what comes next.
images.description: Three matchstick triangles in a row followed by a dotted outline of a fourth, with the question what comes next.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the sticks in one triangle and say what the dotted shape should be.

image_decisions.why: The chapter opener is one clear row of triangles with a dotted next shape; the question is the picture's whole job.
